title_en: Notice of the Supreme People's Court on Authorizing the High People's Court of Yunnan Province to Approve Death Penalty Sentences for Certain Drug Crimes
keywords_en: smuggling; drugs; approval of death sentences for some drug crimes
full_text_en:
SUPREME PEOPLE'S COURT

NOTICE ON AUTHORIZING THE YUNNAN HIGH PEOPLE'S COURT TO APPROVE SOME DEATH PENALTY CASES INVOLVING DRUG CRIMES

Fa (Xing Yi) Fa [1991] No. 18

Yunnan High People's Court:

In order to implement the Decision of the Standing Committee of the National People's Congress on Narcotics Control, to promptly and severely punish criminal activities such as smuggling, trafficking, transporting, and manufacturing drugs, to protect the physical and mental health of citizens, and to maintain public security and social order, pursuant to the provision in Article 13 of the Organic Law of the People's Courts of the People's Republic of China that the Supreme People's Court may, when necessary, authorize the high people's courts of provinces, autonomous regions, and municipalities directly under the Central Government to exercise the power to approve death sentences in cases involving serious endangerment of public security and social order, and following deliberation and decision at the 500th meeting of the Judicial Committee of the Supreme People's Court on June 4, 1991, it is hereby decided as follows: Effective from the date of issuance of this notice, the power to approve death penalty cases involving drug crimes in Yunnan Province (excluding those decided by this Court and those involving foreign elements) is hereby authorized to be exercised by the Yunnan High People's Court in accordance with the law.

This notice is hereby given for your compliance and implementation.

June 6, 1991
